text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoaa... Everything's so sparkly and stylish, it really gives off that "City Girl" vibe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, maybe I took it a bit too easy.
I'd better head back soon—"

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Did any of the clothes catch your eye?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(What should I do... At this rate,
I won't make it in time for training...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I feel bad for the clerk, but
I have no choice but to head back...!)

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of what's popular lately,
skirts like that one over there
have been selling very well in our shop~♪

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: Yes. It's being featured in fashion magazines, and I think it would look wonderful on you, customer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Buzzing in fashion magazines...
Um, could you tell me more about that in detail!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin was so focused on listening to the outfit explanation
that she ended up skipping her training.
